# Native tab controls

Original MIT Windows PE32 fixture for horizontal text tabs, ANSI/Unicode TCITEM
text and LPARAM, item geometry and hit testing, programmatic selection without
notifications, cancellable mouse selection, packed keyboard notifications,
application-owned page visibility and retained page text. Compile with
`npm run build:tabs`; run in ordinary Chromium with `npm run test:tabs`.
